name: Tokyo-International-Cruise-Terminal
tagline: Tokyo in 28 minutes and Toranomon in 28 minutes. Served by 1 line.
summary: The station is in Shinagawa City, served by Yurikamome. Journey times to the main business districts are 34 minutes to Otemachi, 43 minutes to Shinjuku, 40 minutes to Shibuya and 32 minutes to Shinagawa. The station stands 6.7 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 10.2 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 6.7 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from -2.4 m to 7.8 m, a difference of 10.2 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 2 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is less than 0.5 m. For storm surge, 2 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 2 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is フジテレビ湾岸スタジオビル診療所, about 8 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 癌研有明病院, about 40 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
congestion: Yurikamome runs at 92% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 汐留→竹芝, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

neighbours.lead: rent, commuting and the flood projection are all much the same.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Tokyo-International-Cruise-Terminal. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Tokyo-International-Cruise-Terminal.

neighbours.lead: Telecom-Center is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection, but Tokyo-International-Cruise-Terminal is ahead on how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Tokyo-International-Cruise-Terminal. It takes 3 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Tokyo-International-Cruise-Terminal.

noiseSources: The 首都高速湾岸線 viaduct runs just outside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
台場青海線 (3 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 1 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 8 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Yurikamome serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are very lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: The big roads are far enough that traffic noise is unlikely to bother you.
